correctness.rationale: For smooth Delta!=0 the plane quartic has genus 3; explicit Cech basis F^6 extraction yields displayed Hasse–Witt matrix, with det(H)=3*a^2*Delta. At a=0 the rank is exactly 1, and nonzero Frobenius iterates are controlled by -3-2*b^8; the smooth zero-rank condition becomes b^4=4. Two standalone exact SymPy verifiers derive matrix coefficients by distinct homogeneous/affine methods and check 49 finite-field samples, while the symbolic proof covers all k-bar points.

value.rationale: A complete natural two-dimensional Picard family rank stratification gives a codimension-one jump of a-number from 0 to 2, a missing intermediate 7-rank, and an exact four-point zero-rank boundary. This is structural information about moduli/semilinear Frobenius, useful to check and refine general Hasse–Witt uniformity assertions, not a stand-alone numerical exercise.
